_meta.fail_closed: missing/malformed → active=true (loadSafeMode must NOT default to active=false on error)

_schema_notes.fail_closed_design: Frontend loadSafeMode() MUST return active=true on missing/malformed/stale JSON. Defaulting to active=false is a safety regression.
_schema_notes.stale_definition: If last_checked is older than the freshness threshold, treat as active=true (conservative).
_schema_notes.trigger_reason_values: tier1_data_stale | tier_a_t3_violated | crisis_regime | system_error | null (when active=false)
_schema_notes.tier_a_t3_path: T3 hard gate violation → HardGateResult.safe_mode_recommended=True → r9_tier_a passes tier_a_t3_violated=True → safe_mode.active=True
